description: Check whether one claim is true against X posts and public Telegram channels from the 7 days before asOf, and web pages published by then. 1 credit per call whatever the verdict; errors cost nothing. verdict is supported, contradicted or notEnoughEvidence, which means unknown, not false, and also covers a most likely verdict under 0.5. probabilities gives each verdict. evidence holds up to 10 links in all, in one list per source (twitter, telegram, web), most decisive first; basis marks the up to 3 the verdict rests on. coverage.complete false means a source did not answer in time, so the verdict may have missed something. No post or page text is returned, only links.

asOf.description: Unix seconds. Judge the claim as it stood then, reading nothing later. At most 30 days ago and 5 minutes ahead. Defaults to now.

context.description: Background for the judgement, such as how a prediction market resolves. Never treated as evidence, and it does not change what is searched.

decision.description: One more question asked of the same evidence, at no extra cost. yesNo returns yes, the probability the answer is yes. choice returns the most likely label and a probability per label. score returns the expected level, counted from 0, and a probability per level. Null in the result when nothing was found.

statement.description: One checkable claim, as a sentence: who, what and when. Two claims get one verdict.

name: verify
title: Verify
